5e393d5c696b3b0009775c8b: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.
The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.
For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which as mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid the box exploded killing her instantly.
The New Detectives: Murder For Hire

For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.
The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.
The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.
When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.
Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.
The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.
Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.
The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.
The New Detectives: Out To Kill
An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community.  A young woman is dead, the killer gone.  But the marks of his passage remain.

Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.
The New Detectives: Web of Clues
Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.
The New Detectives: Dead In The Water

Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

Luffy ya es consciente del problema que supone enfrentarse a Magellan, pero aun así está dispuesto a dar sus brazos si con ello consigue rescatar a Ace de la ejecución.

Tras la derrota de Luffy, los guardias de Impel Down se lo llevarán al nivel 5 de la prisión para dejarlo morir allí. No obstante, Bon Clay aún no se ha dado por vencido y busca a Ivan, la reina de los travestis, para que le dé su ayuda.

Bon Clay encuentra a Luffy dentro de una celda en plena nieve y se lo lleva con la firme decisión de encontrar a Ivan para que lo salve. No obstante, en mitad del camino se desmaya y despierta solo y desorientado en un sitio lleno de gente muy animada.
En ese sitio tan extraño aparece un tipo todavía más extraño. No es otro que Ivan, esa importante figura de los travestis.
Mientras Luffy se debate entre la vida y la muerte, Ivan le explica con detalle a Bon Clay en qué consiste su poder y qué puede hacer gracias a él.

Luffy se recupera milagrosamente del veneno de Magellan y se decide a seguir con su búsqueda de Ace. Cuando Ivan se entera del verdadero origen de Luffy, este también decide entrar en acción para ayudarlo.
